caption:
Can you play GTA 6 with a racing wheel? Not officially: SlashGear reported on launch day that it only supports controllers, and we found no word from Rockstar on a patch. Racing games do take one. Logitech lists Gran Turismo 7, F1 25, EA Sports WRC, ACC and Forza Horizon 5 for the G29 on PS5, and Forza Motorsport for the G920 on Xbox. Both about $200, our estimate. We earn from qualifying purchases. #gta6 #simracing

GTA 6 and racing wheels, plus a first wheel for each console: https://roomracer.com/launches/gta-6-racing-wheel?src=yt-event
title: Can you play GTA 6 with a racing wheel on PS5 or Xbox?
